| The man sitting on the left slowly opened his eyes and turned his head to look at the woman on the right. His expression gradually changed from calm to surprise. The woman had a gentle and playful smile on her face. She moved closer to the man, bent down and stretched out her arms, naturally lifting the man from his seat and causing his upper body to slightly leave the chair. The man subconsciously held onto the woman's shoulders, his expression slightly bewildered, but he did not resist. After firmly holding the man, the woman quickly approached his face and actively kissed his lips. They maintained this kissing position for a short while, and the sleeves and curtains of the bed moved slightly and naturally with the action. 
The movements are smooth and coherent, the body proportions of the characters are correct, the process of hugging and lifting have a realistic weight effect, and there is no occlusion, limb misalignment or character deformation. Maintain the performance style of vintage costume dramas, soft warm lighting, slight film grain, low saturation image quality and the original video frame rate.
